Coerce a Bioconductor S4 SummarizedExperiment to its S7 equivalent

Source: R/04-coerce-from-s4.R
asSummarizedExperiment7.Rd

Builds a SummarizedExperiment7() (or, if x carries rowRanges, a RangedSummarizedExperiment7()) from a real Bioconductor SummarizedExperiment/RangedSummarizedExperiment S4 object, by reading off assays(), rowData()/rowRanges(), colData(), and metadata(). This is a one-way, read-only snapshot: the result does not stay linked to x, and there is no S7-to-S4 inverse in this package. Note that toSummarizedExperiment7()/toRangedSummarizedExperiment7() are a different operation (moving between this package's own two S7 classes); pass an S4 object to this function, not to those.

Usage

asSummarizedExperiment7(x)

Arguments

x

A SummarizedExperiment or RangedSummarizedExperiment S4 object, as defined by the Bioconductor SummarizedExperiment package.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("SummarizedExperiment", quietly = TRUE)) {
  se4 <- SummarizedExperiment::SummarizedExperiment(
    assays = list(counts = matrix(1:6, nrow = 2, ncol = 3,
      dimnames = list(c("g1", "g2"), c("s1", "s2", "s3")))),
    colData = S4Vectors::DataFrame(
      group = c("a", "a", "b"), row.names = c("s1", "s2", "s3")
    )
  )
  se7 <- asSummarizedExperiment7(se4)
  se7
}
#> <SummarizedExperiment7> 2 x 3
#> assays: counts 
#> rownames: g1, g2 
#> colnames: s1, s2, s3
